title: privacy terms link outside label
rule: Privacy / terms link sits outside the label — not “I agree to the [privacy policy]” as a nested `<a>`. Put the link above, or in a fieldset description via `aria-describedby`.

citation.source: NL Design System — Niet in label

pass_when: Policy/terms link is above the control or in a fieldset description (`aria-describedby`), not nested in the `<label>`.
fail_when: A privacy/terms `<a>` is nested inside the agreement `<label>`.
overview: Privacy and terms links sit outside the agreement label, not nested as an anchor inside it.
apply_when: Linking to privacy or terms beside a consent checkbox.
not_when: Not for plain-text agreement labels with no policy link.
agent_hint: Put policy links above the control or in a fieldset description via aria-describedby.
description: A privacy or terms link must sit outside the label—not “I agree to the [privacy policy]” as a nested `<a>`. Put the link above, or in a fieldset description via `aria-describedby`, so the label stays text-only and operable. Nested anchors inside the agreement label break voice control and screen readers. Fail when a privacy/terms `<a>` is nested inside the agreement `<label>`. Apply beside consent checkboxes that link to policy text.
do_not_claim: Labels-contain-only-text as this privacy-pattern row; contact pages.
